div.div: مَرِيسٌ Dates macerated, or steeped, or soaked, and mashed with the hand, (A, * K,) or moistened, and rubbed and pressed with the fingers till soft, (Mgh,) in water or in milk. (A, O, Mgh.) In the copies of the K, the words فِى المَآءِ are omitted; and immediately after their place follows أَوِاللَّبَنُ [as though meaning, “ or it signifies milk]. ” (TA.) Also, i. q. ثرِيدٌ, q. v. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
